goal: Adopt workload-adaptive page boundaries, universal start-of-task ID and reliable durable checkpoints
policy: At task start allocate ID and persist N000
Never rely on chat short-term memory as sole source
Save after valuable milestone, before risky lengthy operation, and before proactive page switch
If page slow or unable to proceed, use pre-shown ID to recover from latest verified receipt
Never replay confirmed external side effects or UNKNOWN
Only claim browser real-world page A/B with genuine UI evidence
